title: Direct targeting of S100A9 with Icariin counteracted acetaminophen‑induced hepatotoxicity.
authors: Shen, Pan; Xue, Mei; Hu, Zhishuo; Han, Liang; Deng, Xuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究淫羊藿苷靶向S100A9蛋白缓解对乙酰氨基酚肝毒性，核心是药物-蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且方法为MD模拟和SPR但对象无关，故判低分。
abstract: Acetaminophen (APAP) is a widely used antipyretic and analgesic medication, but its overdose can induce acute liver failure with lack of effective therapies. Icariin is a bioactive compound derived from the herb Epimedium that displays hepatoprotective activities. Here, we explored the protective effects and mechanism of icariin on APAP-induced hepatotoxicity. Icariin (25/50 mg/kg) or N-Acetylcysteine (NAC, 300 mg/kg) were orally administered in wild-type C57BL/6 mice for 7 consecutive days before the APAP administration. Icariin attenuated APAP-induced acute liver injury in mice, as measured by alleviated serum enzymes activities and hepatic apoptosis. In vitro, icariin pretreatment significantly inhibited hepatocellular damage and apoptosis by reducing the BAX/Bcl-2 ratio as well as the expression of cleaved-caspase 3 and cleaved-PARP depended on the p53 pathway. Moreover, icariin attenuated APAP-mediated inflammatory response and oxidative stress via the Nrf2 and NF-kappaB pathways. Importantly, icariin reduced the expression of S100A9, icariin interacts with S100A9 as a direct cellular target, which was supported by molecular dynamics simulation and surface plasmon resonance assay (equilibrium dissociation constant, K(D) = 1.14 muM). In addition, the genetic deletion and inhibition of S100A9 not only alleviated APAP-induced injury but also reduced the icariin's protective activity in APAP-mediated liver injury. These data indicated that icariin targeted S100A9 to alleviate APAP-induced liver damage via the following signaling pathways NF-kappaB, p53, and Nrf2.
abstract_zh: 对乙酰氨基酚（APAP）是一种广泛使用的解热镇痛药物，但其过量可诱发急性肝衰竭，且缺乏有效治疗方法。淫羊藿苷（Icariin）是从淫羊藿属植物中提取的一种生物活性化合物，具有肝脏保护活性。本研究探讨了淫羊藿苷对APAP诱导肝毒性的保护作用及其机制。在APAP给药前，对野生型C57BL/6小鼠连续7天口服给予淫羊藿苷（25/50 mg/kg）或N-乙酰半胱氨酸（NAC，300 mg/kg）。淫羊藿苷减轻了APAP诱导的小鼠急性肝损伤，表现为血清酶活性和肝细胞凋亡的缓解。在体外实验中，淫羊藿苷预处理通过降低BAX/Bcl-2比值以及依赖于p53通路的cleaved-caspase 3和cleaved-PARP表达，显著抑制了肝细胞损伤和凋亡。此外，淫羊藿苷通过Nrf2和NF-kappaB通路减轻了APAP介导的炎症反应和氧化应激。重要的是，淫羊藿苷降低了S100A9的表达，且淫羊藿苷与S100A9作为直接细胞靶点相互作用，这一结论得到了分子动力学模拟和表面等离子体共振实验（平衡解离常数，K(D) = 1.14 μM）的支持。此外，S100A9的基因缺失和抑制不仅减轻了APAP诱导的损伤，还降低了淫羊藿苷在APAP介导肝损伤中的保护活性。这些数据表明，淫羊藿苷靶向S100A9，通过NF-kappaB、p53和Nrf2信号通路减轻APAP诱导的肝损伤。
